title: Treesa-Gayatri, Hariharan-Arjun Advance at Japan Masters
indian_angle: Indian pairs Treesa Jolly/Gayatri Gopichand and Hariharan Amsakarunan/M.R. Arjun secured wins in the Japan Masters, progressing to the next round.
summary: Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand moved into the round of 16 in straight games against the World No. 15 pair, while Hariharan Amsakarunan and M.R. Arjun also advanced after their former world champion opponents retired.

title: Tanvi Patri's Unique Journey Forged in China, Eyes World Title
indian_angle: This feature highlights India's rising badminton sensation Tanvi Patri, detailing her unique training background and aspirations for major titles.
summary: India's new badminton sensation Tanvi Patri, whose unique journey was forged in China, is setting her sights on the world junior title and LA Olympics qualification.

title: BAI Forms New Athletes Committee for Player Representation
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India has announced the formation of its new Athletes Committee, aiming to provide better representation and support for Indian players.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has officially announced the formation of its Athletes Committee, a move aimed at enhancing player involvement in governance and decision-making processes.

title: Eligibility List Released for 49th Junior National Badminton Championships

summary: The eligibility list for the Yonex-Sunrise 49th Junior National Badminton Championships 2026, scheduled for November 14-21 in Sikkim, has been published.

title: National Coaching Camp for BWF World Junior Championships 2026
indian_angle: A national coaching camp is underway at NCE, Guwahati, preparing Indian junior players for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships 2026.
summary: Indian junior badminton players are attending a national coaching camp at the National Centre of Excellence in Guwahati, in preparation for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.
